info.title: Hotel Management API
info.description:
Generated from the live route table: paths, required permissions and request schemas come from the code itself.

**Conventions** — Money is an integer in minor units (VND has none: 150000 = 150,000 VND). Dates in stays are hotel-local `YYYY-MM-DD` keys; instants are ISO-8601 UTC. Lists return `data: []` plus `meta: {page, limit, total, totalPages}`. Errors: `{success:false, message, code, errors[], requestId}`. Browser clients authenticate with HTTP-only cookies and must send `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` on state-changing requests.
